assessments.summary: The midpoint-vector identities are correct and establish that each side of the medial triangle is parallel to the corresponding side of ABC and has half its length. An explicit similarity maps ABC to DEF with ratio 1/2, while dilations about A, B, and C map ABC to the three corner triangles with the same ratio. Thus the stated midpoint lemma and corresponding half-scale assertions are established.
scopeQualifications: The conclusion assumes the usual nondegenerate-triangle setting so side lengths and triangle similarity are nontrivial.
